title: SkyPark at Santa's Village launched a joyful July sale with big Christmas vibes
text:
The merry midcentury destination is summoning seasonal sweetness in the hot heart of summer.
may be in charge of all sorts of cheery tasks, including gift wrapping and reindeer grooming and cookie decorating and the casting of enchanted spells, but we're not sure if they ever influence the weather.
If they could control the thermometer, we might kindly ask them to lower temperatures just a pinch; we wouldn't even beg for snow, what with it being the sizzling heart of summer and all. Also, the area's industrious elves have got bigger plans in the whimsical works: The annual Christmas in July sale just commenced at, all to give families, holiday mavens, and all lovers of wintry whimsy the jubilant jump on tickets.
And not only a jump, as the tickets on sale from July 15-31 are discounted, all to help people plan a few months ahead.all told — we will be in the busy throes of pre-holiday events in five festive months — and the midcentury attraction knows that fans want to map out their merriment and enjoy a deal on admission to the charming mountaintop destination along the way. You can also book the popular Breakfast with Santa or Tea with Mrs. Claus, too, two sought-after experiences that give guests a chance to hobnob with the beloved figures.
And if you're seeking some fresh decorations when it comes time to trim your tree, Christmas ornaments will be marked at 50% off through the end of July at Santa's Village. For every ensorcelled thing happening during the fa, la, sale,
